text:
- **Owner questions:** Agents can ask the owner a question with the ask tool. The owner answers on the site or in chat. The answer that arrives first wins. A site answer reaches a Claude Code session in under a second. Codex sessions receive a queued site answer. Live checks passed on both runtimes.
- **CI speed:** A pull request runs only the Go test packages its changed files can affect. Go test compute fell sharply on non-store pull requests. A docs-only pull request skips the Go test jobs. Median CI wall time is still above its goal. The Go test target now passes on every run.
- **Owner replies and modes:** Owner replies reach a session by push alone. The pm reply wait command and the inbox hook are removed. Interactive and autopilot modes now gate the owner-request judge for each session. Agents open a project, sprint or task the owner asked for without asking leave first.
- **Code and design records:** The command-line package is split by noun. Python-port leftovers are deleted. AGENTS.md is a short map. An agent grades it against a rubric on every pull request. pm no longer installs a git hook or sets the hooks path. Automatic memory is off in this repo. A survey of long-horizon agent benchmarks was written.
